title.zh: OpenCode披露云端入侵，团队称持续遭攻击48小时，防守AI半路拒答
title.en: OpenCode披露云端入侵，团队称持续遭攻击48小时，防守AI半路拒答

current_state.zh: OpenCode disclosed a cloud Console intrusion affecting 1.4% of users and potentially exposing third-party model API keys after 48 hours of continuous agent-driven attacks, and reported that frontier models refused parts of its incident-response analysis until OpenAI granted the team vetted 'Daybreak Blue' security access, a friction that drew public criticism from David Sacks over uniform model guardrails.
